q1.q: Which part of your car audio has the problem?

q_hu.q: What does the head unit do?

options.label: Turns on but there is no sound
Bluetooth, USB or radio not working

q_hu_ns.q: Do you have an external amplifier?

options.label: No, the unit drives the speakers directly
Sound cuts out on bumps or turns
LED or headlights flicker or fail

r_hu_power.issue: Blown fuse, loose power wire or failed head unit
r_hu_power.detail: Usually a fuse or wiring harness fault. A technician checks constant 12V, ignition feed and ground first.

r_hu_freeze.issue: Software crash or failing board / memory
r_hu_freeze.detail: Common on cheap Android units. Often fixed by a reflash or power-supply repair.

r_hu_conn.issue: Faulty Bluetooth module, USB port or antenna connection
r_hu_conn.detail: A loose antenna lead or a dead module. Usually a quick bench repair.

r_amp_protect.detail: Caused by a shorted speaker wire, bad ground or a missing remote turn-on wire.

r_hu_ns.issue: Muted output, loose speaker wiring or blown output stage
r_hu_ns.detail: Check mute and fader settings first, then speaker wires and the harness.

r_sp_distort.issue: Damaged speaker cone, gain set too high or loose wiring
r_sp_distort.detail: Lower the gain and check the speaker. A torn cone needs replacing.

r_sp_one.issue: Disconnected or broken speaker wire, or a blown speaker
r_sp_one.detail: A technician tests the wire and the speaker coil with a meter.

r_sp_bass.issue: Subwoofer or amp not powered, wrong phase or blown woofer
r_sp_bass.detail: Check amp power light and remote wire. A blown woofer needs replacing.

r_sp_noise.issue: Ground loop or poor ground (often alternator whine)
r_sp_noise.detail: Fixed by cleaning the ground point and rerouting power and signal cables.

r_el_drain.issue: Memory and ignition wires swapped, or amp staying on
r_el_drain.detail: A parasitic draw test finds the circuit. Usually a wiring correction.

r_el_fuse.detail: Do not fit a bigger fuse. The short must be traced and repaired.

r_el_loose.issue: Loose connector or poor ground connection
r_el_loose.detail: Re-crimp or re-seat connectors and secure the ground to bare metal.

r_cm_cam.issue: Cable break, loose video connector or failed camera
r_cm_cam.detail: Often the cable breaks at the tailgate hinge.

r_cm_sens.issue: Faulty sensor, damaged wiring or control box
r_cm_sens.detail: Each sensor is tested to find the dead one.

r_cm_led.issue: Bad driver / ballast, poor connection or low-quality bulbs
r_cm_led.detail: Flicker is usually a weak driver or a loose plug.
